subject.title: Allow multiple account in the status bar for same provider.

question: Should per-account status bar items now move from accepted design into product behavior, and should they use the documented replacement mode instead of the original additive toggle?
rationale: Current main intentionally stops at account menu cards; the next step changes persisted status-item behavior, Merge Icons semantics, and auth/account presentation.

options.title: Approve documented selected-account icons
options.body: Implement the Phase 2 replacement mode from the design document, preserving one provider/status-item source of truth and privacy-safe labels.

options.title: Keep the issue parked
options.body: Leave the request open until broader same-provider instance work, such as https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1843, is decided.

options.title: Choose additive account toggles
options.body: Allow selected accounts to add extra icons while the provider item remains, accepting the extra Merge Icons and autosave complexity.

recommendation.title: Approve documented selected-account icons
recommendation.body: Implement the Phase 2 replacement mode from the design document, preserving one provider/status-item source of truth and privacy-safe labels.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the accepted design and already framed the remaining decision in the issue discussion.
